name: Matt Bunch

bio.statement: His official page describes him as state representative for House District 51, representing Canby, Estacada and Sandy.
bio.excerpt: the State Representative for House District 51 representing the communities of Canby, Estacada, Sandy.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Bunch member page

bio.statement: The Capital Chronicle voter guide describes Bunch as an insurance agent from Beavercreek appointed after Sen. Christine Drazan moved to the Senate.
bio.excerpt: Matt Bunch, an insurance agent from Beavercreek, was appointed last fall after Sen. Christine Drazan, R-Canby,

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

bio.statement: OPB reports Bunch described himself as a neighbor and grandfather, not a career politician.

source.publisher: OPB

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists Bunch's occupation as State Representative and insurance broker, with a background in finance and management.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Representative, Insurance Broker Occupational Background: Finance, Management

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 54

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists Oregon State University as his educational background and the Clackamas County Fair Board, Soil & Water Conservation District and Farm Bureau as prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: Oregon State University Prior Governmental Experience: Clackamas County Fair Board Chair, Clackamas County Soil & Water Conservation District, Clackamas County Farm Bureau President

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: At his appointment, OPB reports Bunch said schools should remove politics from learning to focus on core academic skills.

source.publisher: OPB

positions.statement: Bunch's pamphlet statement says he supports fully funding law enforcement, strengthening accountability and ensuring communities have tools to protect residents.
positions.excerpt: I support fully funding law enforcement, strengthening accountability, and ensuring our communities have the tools they need to protect residents.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Bunch's pamphlet statement says he is fighting to protect tax relief for working Oregonians, including eliminating state taxes on tips and overtime.
positions.excerpt: I’m fighting to protect tax relief for working Oregonians, including eliminating state taxes on tips and overtime so people can keep more of what they earn.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 54

positions.statement: Bunch's pamphlet statement says he will keep working to reduce unnecessary regulations and support policies that help local employers grow and hire.
positions.excerpt: I will continue working to reduce unnecessary regulations and support policies that help local employers grow and hire.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 54
